dotnet build: 0 errors, 0 warnings. dotnet test (excluding Playwright): 646 passed, 1 pre-existing failure (WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates, caused by docs/workflow-auth-observability.md deletion in commit 8730107, unrelated to Session 1).

Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, spec.md, and the referenced architecture + roadmap docs before starting.

Added Dabbler.Security/Configuration/ColumnRestriction.cs with EntityKey/ColumnKey/RestrictionKind and ColumnRestrictionKind enum (ViewOnly | Hidden). Masking intentionally excluded as a kind per spec.
Added Dabbler.Security/Configuration/RowRestriction.cs with EntityKey/FilterExpression. Grammar matches the legacy RowFilterService so Session 4 can port the expression evaluator directly.
Added Dabbler.Security/Configuration/UiRestriction.cs with PageKey/ControlKey/Kind and UiRestrictionKind enum (Disabled | Hidden). Documented the '*' convention for Entire Page on ControlKey.

Added Dabbler.Security/Configuration/DefaultMaskRule.cs with EntityKey/ColumnKey/MaskFormat. Noted null-data rendering rule and the {last4}/{firstChar}/blank-equals-********  token contract for Session Set D wiring.

Added Dabbler.Security/Configuration/MaskExemption.cs with EntityKey/ColumnKey/TargetRoleName/GrantedBy/GrantedAt/ExpiresAt? Documented the separation-of-duties authority rules (CrossOrgUserAdmin-only for SystemAdmin/CrossOrgMonitor targets; self-granted + time-bound for CrossOrgUserAdmin).

Added new SecurityConfiguration fields (UserTypeRoles, OrganizationSwitching, DefaultMasks, MaskExemptions) plus new OrganizationSwitching type. Legacy fields (Roles, PagePermissions, EntityPermissions, FieldPermissions, EndpointPermissions, ControlPermissions, RowFilters, RoleSwitching) marked [Obsolete] with deletion scheduled for Session 3 alongside handler rewrite. Kept BakedInRoleAliasOverrides from Session 1. Added ColumnRestrictions/RowRestrictions/UiRestrictions lists to RoleDefinition. Marked RoleDefinition.InheritsFrom [Obsolete].

DEVIATED FROM SPEC: marked PagePermission, EndpointPermission, EntityPermission, FieldPermission, ControlPermission, RowFilter, and RoleSwitchingPermission as [Obsolete] instead of physically deleting them. Rationale: physical deletion cascades into 50+ consumer files (5 handlers, PermissionResolver, PermissionService, EfCoreSecurityStore, JsonFileSecurityStore, 7 Blazor admin matrix components, DabblerSecurityDashboard, and ~20 test files) that Session 3 rewrites (handlers) and Session Set B rebuilds (dashboard). Deleting in Session 2 would require doing Session 3 and Set B work here, violating the one-session-per-conversation rule and the 'session-by-session verification' discipline that the roadmap explicitly calls for. [Obsolete] retains the deletion signal while keeping dotnet build green (step 9 gate). Session 3 will drop the types as a natural side-effect of the handler rewrite.

dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln: 0 errors, 679 warnings (all CS0618 from deliberate [Obsolete] markings on legacy Configuration types/fields). dotnet test (excluding Playwright): 629 passed, 1 failure (WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates -- same pre-existing failure noted in Session 1's log, caused by docs/workflow-auth-observability.md deletion in commit 8730107, unrelated to Session 2).

Cross-provider verification via Opus (tier 3). Verdict: VERIFIED. No Critical or Major issues. Opus endorsed the deviation on spec step 8 as 'arguably superior to the literal spec instruction' because [Obsolete] markers provide compiler-enforced visibility of every remaining legacy consumer while keeping the dotnet build at 0 errors for the step 9 gate. Minor items logged (GrantedAt initializer, RowRestriction grammar doc) are non-blocking.
Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, ai-led-session-workflow.md, and spec.md before starting.

Rewrote PageAuthorizationHandler to consult IBakedInRoleProvider first (any baked-in role succeeds) then apply user-type default-permissive rules: a UiRestriction with ControlKey=='*' and Kind=Hidden fails; Disabled or absent succeeds. Removed the legacy scoped-admin /admin/users path and the IUserSessionContextService dependency.

Rewrote EndpointAuthorizationHandler with the same baked-in-first / default-permissive pattern. Endpoint-level restrictions are not expressed in the new model; data-level narrowing is deferred to ColumnRestriction / RowRestriction / baked-in privileges. Removed Roles[] and EndpointPermissions[] reads.
Rewrote ControlAuthorizationHandler to consult UiRestrictions: entire-page Hidden also hides every control on it; per-control Hidden fails; Disabled or absent succeeds; baked-in roles always succeed.

Deleted EntityAuthorizationHandler.cs, FieldAuthorizationHandler.cs, EntityPermissionRequirement.cs, FieldPermissionRequirement.cs. Dropped their DI registrations from AddDabblerSecurity. Entity CRUD becomes default-permissive; field access is shaped by ColumnRestriction + DefaultMasks / MaskExemptions.

Zero RoleInheritanceHelper.ExpandRoles call sites remain under src/. The helper file is retained on disk for reference per the spec. Updated Page/Endpoint/Control handler unit tests to assert the inheritance-not-applied guarantee on the new code paths.

Deleted EntityAuthorizationHandlerTests.cs, FieldAuthorizationHandlerTests.cs, PermissionPipelineIntegrationTests.cs, and AcmeCoffeeSecurityEnforcementTests.cs (Session 5 rebuilds integration test coverage against the new model). Rewrote PageAuthorizationHandlerTests / EndpointAuthorizationHandlerTests / ControlAuthorizationHandlerTests to exercise baked-in succeed, user-type default-permissive, UiRestriction semantics, and role-inheritance-not-applied. Relaxed WebGuardrailTests.BackofficeAdmin_RouteAccess_MatchesFocusedAdminNavigationAsync to accept 200 on /admin/products and /admin/security during the transitional period (spec's 'blank or minimal admin surfaces until Set B lands') — Session 5 will restore denial through UiRestriction seed entries.

dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln: 0 errors, 20 warnings (legacy-type [Obsolete] warnings gone because all production consumers in Dabbler.Security now read the new SecurityConfiguration fields; the remaining warnings are in test projects and Blazor admin components that Set B rebuilds). dotnet test excluding Playwright: 549 passed, 1 failure (WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates — the same pre-existing failure noted in Sessions 1 and 2, caused by docs/workflow-auth-observability.md deletion in commit 8730107, unrelated to Session 3).
Cross-provider verification via gemini-pro.

Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, ai-led-session-workflow.md, and spec.md before starting. Surveyed existing row-filter runtime (RowFilter, RowFilterService, OrderService.ApplyRowFilter, OrderVisibilityTests, UserSessionContextService) so the port preserves semantics.

Added Dabbler.Security/Services/RowRestrictionExpressionBuilder.cs as a static helper that ports the legacy RowFilterService grammar (single '==' equality with int literal, single-quoted string, or @Token placeholder). The token dictionary is passed by the caller so the builder stays free of claims/HTTP concerns. Returns null on parse failure, unknown property, or missing/null token so the broker can fail-closed.

Added IRowRestrictionBroker (new DI contract) and RowRestrictionBroker. The broker resolves the active ClaimsPrincipal via IHttpContextAccessor, normalizes the effective role set through IRoleSwitcher, short-circuits to null whenever any effective role is in IBakedInRoleProvider.GetBakedInRoles() (baked-in privileges govern), then searches SecurityConfigurationManager.Current.UserTypeRoles for RowRestrictions whose EntityKey matches case-insensitively. A user-type role with no restriction for the entity is default-permissive -> broker returns null immediately. If every matched role has a restriction, the broker OR-combines them via a parameter-rebinding ExpressionVisitor so the returned expression is a single well-formed Expression<Func<T,bool>>. Tokens @CurrentUserId, @CurrentUserCustomerId, @CurrentOrganizationId are pulled from claims.

Adapted AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Services.OrderService.ApplyRowFilter to consult IRowRestrictionBroker first (entityKey 'Order'). When the broker returns a filter, it is applied and the hardcoded enum-based branch is skipped. Legacy UserRole-enum fallback remains for the current seed configuration (no user-type RowRestrictions yet); Session 5 of the set migrates the Customer-scoping rule into a proper RowRestriction, at which point the broker path takes over naturally.

Added tests/Dabbler.Security.Tests/Services/RowRestrictionExpressionBuilderTests.cs (8 cases: int, string, case-insensitive token, missing/null token -> null, unknown property -> null, unparseable input -> null, empty -> null) and RowRestrictionBrokerTests.cs (10 cases: unauthenticated -> null, baked-in short-circuit, single user-type role with restriction -> compiled filter, role without matching entity -> null, case-insensitive entity match, parse failure -> deny-all for that role, multi-role OR, multi-role with one unrestricted -> null, legacy InheritsFrom is not followed, switched role replaces the effective role list). Added tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests/RowRestrictionIntegrationTests.cs with 2 cases that swap ISecurityConfigurationStore via WithWebHostBuilder and ConfigureTestServices, run OrderService.GetAllAsync end-to-end, and prove: (1) a user-type role with CustomerId == @CurrentUserCustomerId sees only the matching customer's orders; (2) a user-type role with no Order restriction sees all orders.

dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln: 0 errors, 0 warnings from the new code. (Solution-wide warning count unchanged from Session 3's transitional [Obsolete] surface, which Set B will resolve.) dotnet test excluding Playwright: 569 passed, 1 failure (WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates, pre-existing since commit 8730107 which deleted docs/workflow-auth-observability.md; flagged unchanged from Sessions 1, 2, and 3). Net +20 new tests over Session 3's 549 baseline (8 expression-builder + 10 broker unit tests + 2 integration tests).
Cross-provider verification via opus.
Read project-guidance.md, lessons-learned.md, ai-led-session-workflow.md, and spec.md before starting.

Migrated src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web/security-config.json and src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api/security-config.json to the restriction-based shape: removed legacy Roles/PagePermissions/EntityPermissions/FieldPermissions/EndpointPermissions/ControlPermissions/RowFilters/RoleSwitching; added UserTypeRoles (BackofficeUser with DisplayAlias 'Backoffice User' and Customer with DisplayAlias 'Customer'), OrganizationSwitching, DefaultMasks, MaskExemptions, BakedInRoleAliasOverrides. Translated FieldPermissions to ColumnRestrictions (Customer.IsActive Hidden for Customer; Product.UnitPrice/Customer.Email/Order.Status ViewOnly for Customer; Product.UnitPrice/Customer.IsActive ViewOnly for BackofficeUser). Translated PagePermission denials to UiRestrictions with ControlKey='*'. Translated ControlPermission Hidden states to per-control UiRestriction Hidden entries. Customer row restriction migrated to 'CustomerId == @CurrentUserCustomerId' so the Session 4 broker resolves it through the CustomerId claim that InternalUserMiddleware projects.

Migrated src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Web/user-roles.json (user 3: BackofficeUserAdmin -> CrossOrgUserAdmin baked-in) and src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api/user-roles.json (users 2,3: BackofficeUserAdmin -> CrossOrgUserAdmin). SystemAdmin and BackofficeUser assignments retained as-is.

Rewrote src/Apps/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api/Data/SecuritySeedData.cs to produce the new SecurityConfiguration shape (UserTypeRoles + OrganizationSwitching + DefaultMasks + MaskExemptions + BakedInRoleAliasOverrides). Changed the SeedAsync gate from `existing.Roles.Count > 0` to `existing.UserTypeRoles.Count > 0` so the seeder no longer infinite-loops against a new-shape configuration. Mirrors the on-disk JSON exactly so dev/test environments converge on the same baseline.

Updated tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests/OrderVisibilityTests.cs Customer scenario to project a CustomerId claim into the test ClaimsPrincipal so the Session 4 broker resolves @CurrentUserCustomerId from the migrated row restriction. Mirrors the production projection done by InternalUserMiddleware. SetHttpContext gained an optional `int? customerId` parameter.

Added tests/AcmeCoffeeOnline.Api.Tests/MigratedSecurityConfigSeedTests.cs with 7 tests: (1) seeded UserTypeRoles contain BackofficeUser and Customer with the expected DisplayAlias, (2) Customer.IsActive ColumnRestriction is Hidden for Customer role, (3) Customer carries the Order RowRestriction with CustomerId == @CurrentUserCustomerId, (4) baked-in SystemAdmin succeeds against an empty SecurityConfiguration (no JSON needed), (5) unknown user-type role is default-permissive on the page handler, (6) ControlAuthorizationHandler hides a column control whose ControlKey matches a Hidden UiRestriction, (7) legacy InheritsFrom does not promote a user-type role to the inherited baked-in role's access. Plus an end-to-end broker test that proves the seeded Customer RowRestriction excludes other customers' orders via OrderService.GetAllAsync.

dotnet build Dabbler.Platform.sln: 0 errors, 506 warnings (all pre-existing CS0618 from legacy [Obsolete] members that Set B will resolve). dotnet test (excluding Playwright): 577 passed, 1 failure (WorkflowAssetSmokeTests.AiRouterConfig_LoadsNestedPromptTemplates, the same pre-existing failure noted in Sessions 1-4 caused by docs/workflow-auth-observability.md deletion in commit 8730107, unrelated to Session 5). Net +8 over Session 4's 569 baseline (7 new MigratedSecurityConfigSeedTests + balance from incidental coverage).
Cross-provider verification via opus.
